correctness.rationale: The canonical published centered sum is reindexed correctly for m-n=4. All five coefficient expressions are derived from exact finite quadratic sums and symbolically verified for arbitrary h. The reduced quartic has positive values at -2, negative values at -3 and positive leading coefficient; Descartes of F(-2-u) has precisely two sign variations for both n mod 4 families. This proves exactly two simple roots below -2; published Fejér positivity eliminates all [-2,2] real reduced roots and positive coefficient polynomial positivity eliminates all >2. Two remaining nonreal reduced roots and reciprocal quadratic lifting give eight simple roots, exactly four inside, including the stated sharp interval separation. Symbolic and finite checker passed 694 assertions, but infinite proof is analytic.

value.rationale: The all-gap 2026 theorem counts zeros with multiplicity, leaving their distinctness and geometry unresolved. Numerator gap four is the first higher even gap beyond the 2025 fully computed gap two, and all odd denominators form a natural infinite family. The theorem gives a complete, exact, parameter-uniform classification of real and nonreal genuine oblique-slice Bergman zero levels, excluding multiple roots and providing two strict universal isolating intervals. It does not claim a full two-variable classification or arbitrary-gap result.
